title: type-check coverage: graduate the last three DEBT packages (cloud-connection, hono, observability) — the remainder of #4311
body:
Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) as the one carrier the maintainer's 「4311 关」 creates. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Graded here: `tooling` · `priority:p3` · `domain:cli` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`.

## Where #4311 ended

#4311 (July) measured 66 of 77 packages building with `tsup` and no `tsc` reading them, with 380 code-tier errors across 18 packages. Its three proposals have all landed on `main` (read at `41dcf11884`):
1. **The coverage ratchet.** `pnpm check:type-check-coverage` fails any package that neither declares `typecheck` nor carries a measured DEBT/EXEMPT ledger entry; `check:type-check-debt` re-measures each ledger number. 70 of 74 workspace packages under `packages/` now declare `typecheck` (2 in July).
2. **The test-layer template.** Per-package `tsconfig.test.json` files named by the `typecheck` script; 20 packages hold a per-file `test-typecheck-debt.json`.
3. **The code-tier burn-down.** `driver-sql` (241 of the 380) and the other big entries graduated.

## What is left (this card)

Three packages still have **no `typecheck` script** and sit in the `DEBT` ledger of `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`. All three are `domain:cli` surfaces:

| package | ledgered | ledger note |
|---|---:|---|
| `@objectstack/cloud-connection` | 13 | code-tier 11 (TS2493 tuple indexing) + 2 config-tier |
| `@objectstack/observability` | 11 | all code-tier (TS2554 wrong arity ×10, TS2552) |
| `@objectstack/hono` (`packages/adapters/hono`) | 3 | all code-tier (TS2769 / TS18046) |

**Direction, per package** (the road #15048 / #15050 took):
- Add a `tsconfig.test.json` over the test layer and a `typecheck` script that names it.
- Re-measure first and say both readings (the build config vs the test config), so config-tier and code-tier are separated before anything is fixed.
- Fix each code-tier error at its cause: a mock typed to the call site it stubs, the call's real arity. ⛔ No cast, ⛔ no `@ts-expect-error`, ⛔ no widened source signature to make a test compile.
- Delete the `DEBT` entry, don't lower it. The gate's RECONCILED direction then holds the package.

A package whose errors turn out to be a real source defect (not a test shape) is split to its own card instead of being fixed under this one.

**Not here:**
- `@objectstack/console` is `EXEMPT` (a published objectui build artifact with no TypeScript sources). That is correct and stays.
- The `spec-monorepo` root entry (26, almost all one missing `types:["node"]` on the root program). It is not a package and moves with `scripts/`; it is not this card's.

**Why p3.** Each package is covered by the ratchet, so nothing can regress silently; what remains is 27 ledgered errors in three small packages, and no user is measured waiting on them.
